notes: Two branches (Abu Bakr→Shababa; Muhammad b. al-Walid→Muhammad b. Ja'far) meet at «قالا حدثنا شعبة»: the tail from شعبة onward belongs to both.
«- رجل من أهل الشام من أصحاب رسول الله ... قال -» is an editor's gloss, left out; Miqdam, who relays the Prophet's words, is the last link.
«وربما قال فإلى الله وإلى رسوله» is a wording variant and is left out.
